run_test_op: run unit tests for a Lie group operator checking jacobian consistency and multi-batch output
sample_inputs: sample random tensor inputs of specified types for Lie group operator testing
check_lie_group_function: check that Lie group function jacobians from autograd match custom backward implementations
check_jacrev_unary: check vmap jacrev works for unary Lie group operations like exp and inv
check_binary_op_broadcasting: check binary Lie group operations like compose and transform handle broadcasting correctly
